actions.action: Migrate to Eclipse 3.0.1. Migrate the J2EE personality to JBoss 4.0. to allow JDK1.5 on container site.
Add support for the Hibernate O/R mapping tool in the DOG framework. Addapt accordingly the code generator of pmMDA.
Define nicer icons for the pmMDA project and its group.

release.action: Create an initial version of the Forrest site and upload it to the source forge site. The pmMDA group should review the site and provide feedback. Extend the tutorials describing how to generate a compilable and executable application with pmMDA. See pmMDA site
Migrate the project to Eclipse 3.0. Find compatible versions of the used plugins for the new version. Test the compile, debug, test, and release cycle with the new environment.
Update all external components used in the projects to the latest released version. In particular all Apache and Jakarta should be synchronized.
